RATIONALE: the 120 s idle watchdog false-killed ~84% of 30B coder candidates on the 2026-07-12 battery (16/19) -- it cannot tell a slow-generating 30B (first-token starvation / long thinking bursts) from a genuinely wedged one. 600 s is the right-censored, conservative recalibration. research_docs_note: #1206 the coder's LOCAL offline docset lookup (tools/search_docs.py, exposed to opencode as ~/.config/opencode/tool/search_docs.js). The `research_docs` key above this line is the SINGLE knob, and IT is the authority on the current state -- read it, never this note. Only the JSON boolean `true` arms the tool; a string "true", a 1, a typo or a missing key all mean OFF. ARMING THE TOOL IS NOT INSTRUCTING THE CODER: the knob makes the lookup available, and a separate build-time instruction (#1320) is what makes a coder reach for it. Armed-and-mute is therefore a real and expected state, and zero lookups while armed is not evidence the knob is off. DURABILITY (operator bar, 2026-07-30): the tool RE-READS this file at the point of use on EVERY call (resolve_arming, resolved relative to its own file location), so the state survives device reboots, crash relaunches and hand-started processes. It is never carried by process-environment inheritance, which would arm only whoever happened to be spawned by the right parent and leave every already-running process silently dormant. BLARAI_RESEARCH_DOCS in the environment can only ever DISARM: a falsy value is an emergency stop honoured even inside a running process, a truthy one does nothing. A manifest that cannot be read reports `unresolved` -- refused fail-closed, but never reported as a deliberate 'switched off'. Flipping this to true is a build-time CAPABILITY change: an LA/coordinator go-live step and a battery-attribution event (#740 one-change-per-run) -- never a silent edit, never mid-campaign. Every spawn appends an arming record to state/research-arming.jsonl; every lookup the coder actually makes appends a `search_docs_cli` record to state/research-usage.jsonl. Serving CODER_DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md capability 6; that row, not this note, records what the build-time half has so far been observed to do.
